title: Behavior-control tests on Holmesburg prison inmates

tellings.quote: Tests were conducted on inmates at Holmesburg State Prison in Philadelphia, a full decade after MK Ultra had officially supposedly been shut down.

plain: Behavior-control tests were run on inmates at Holmesburg prison in Philadelphia "a full decade after MK Ultra had officially supposedly been shut down," Michels says, MK Ultra being the CIA's programme of mind-control experiments. He tells it himself, without naming a source, in an episode on drug companies and human experiments; if true, it would mean such work went on long after it was said to have ended.
